summary: Vulcan Infrastructure & Power Inc. filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, announcing delivery of a notice to redeem all outstanding 8.50% Senior Notes due 2026. The redemption is expected on October 13, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest. The filing also disclosed preliminary unaudited cash and digital-asset balances as of September 30, 2026, and pro forma balances after redemption and remaining PIPE-expense payments. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The redemption removes the 2026 Notes from the capital structure, effectively deleveraging the issuer; watch for closing mechanics, note delisting, and any liquidity signal from post-redemption cash disclosure.
